timeline.title: Q2 GDP due Monday; 7.6–7.8% expected
timeline.line: Official July–September growth data is due on 30 November
more: A Mint poll sees 7.6%, down from 7.8% the previous quarter

The data lands days before the RBI policy decision on 4 December
